Family Cast

Everyone who lives in Daddy's memory places, as a kid back then and as they are now. Each one has a storybook character sheet and a few designed voices saying a line of their own. I picked a voice for everyone; tap any to hear it, and change a character's voice, how it speaks or its sound pack right on its card. Ticked details are the ones you told me; the rest are placeholders for you to correct.

Designed voices, never clonedStorybook characters, no photosOne voice per character, shared by every game

How it is made

  • The sheets live in tools/voice-cast/cast.json. Every voice is made by ElevenLabs Voice Design from a written description (a voice actor performing the character), with three takes per description.
  • Your pick becomes a saved voice, and every memory place (the school jump, Grace's basement, the Moon base) voices its lines with it.
  • The portraits are drawn from the sheets. Hi-fi character art follows once the Mac's picture tool is cleared for the family.
